discourse.title: Love is the only offering I accept
discourse.excerpt: I accept only one offering from the World, Love - sacred selfless Love, manifested as service, as brotherhood, as tenderness of heart, as compassion.
discourse.theme: The only offering Swami accepts is sacred, selfless love — shown as service, brotherhood, tenderness of heart and compassion.

reflection: Swami returns a large money offering and names what he actually accepts: love made visible as service, brotherhood and compassion. Today, offer that instead of a thing — serve someone quietly, speak tenderly where you would usually be sharp, and treat a stranger as a brother or sister. (Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 18, 21 Nov 1985)
seva_nudge: Offer one act of service today with no name attached — leave help where it is needed and walk away without waiting to be thanked.
